_purpose: Reference snapshot of exactly what this pipeline pulls and how it converts it. Not read by any script -- update by hand if the defaults in prepare.py/seasons.py/fetch.py change.

raw_features_available.observation.state.tcp: [24] float32 -- NOT used, confirmed identically zero for this platform (no EEF tracking)
raw_features_available.observation.tactile: [60] float32 (5 fingers x 6 F6 dims x 2 hands) -- used, as `tacf6_hist` (30 Hz window)
raw_features_available.observation.images.head_right: 480x480 video -- NOT fetched (slow expert takes a single head image)
raw_features_available.observation.images.tactile_raw: 480x1600 video -- NOT fetched (73% of a season's bytes, no encoder consumes it)

action_representation: all-absolute -- no delta, no anchoring; action_chunk[k] = action[min(t+k, episode_end)] for k in 0..15

prep_config_defaults.sample_stride: 5 (pilot) / 20 (full tier) -- emits every Nth source frame
prep_config_defaults.phase_mode: none (or 'progress' to bake '(fold k of 6)' into the prompt)

output_row_schema.frame_index: int32 -- t - episode_start (episode-relative; join key for post-hoc annotation)
output_row_schema.tacf6_hist: [16*60] float32 flat -- tactile[clip(t-15+i, episode_start, t)], native 30Hz regardless of sample_stride
output_row_schema.deform: binary JPEG, 1200x480 (2x5 grid of 240x240 per-finger deform maps)

single_season_smoke_test.instance: vast.ai, 96 vCPU / 251GB RAM / RTX 4080 Super, ~2.2Gbps down
